candidateRule.statement: Evidence representation may raise the inspection ceiling, but it cannot authorize scientific support strength, truth, causality, or generalization without Study-owned inference authority.

counterexamples.attack: Exact upstream figure/table bytes are present, therefore the associated scientific claim is supported.
A gold evidence identity without locally materialized pixels should be treated as no evidence annotation.
A claim with more annotated evidence links automatically has stronger or more independent scientific support.
Each claim-evidence link is an independent evidence object.
Full-text availability authorizes a method-adequacy or claim-validity judgment.
Challenge-test media can be used to infer or reconstruct withheld gold evidence labels.
Dataset-level CC BY 4.0 automatically authorizes external redistribution/commercial reuse of every underlying paper media object, or rights restrictions alter scientific support strength.
The source-native Context24 claim id is a globally unique claim identity and may collapse all rows sharing it.

explicitlyNotAdmitted: ClaimPermission as a shared executable policy
automatic scientific-support grading from representation state
external media redistribution or commercial reuse authority
